name: Question 2
problem:
Evaluate the double integral ${∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A$, where

$$
f(x,y)=\{\begin{aligned}3{x}^{2},\, & \text{if}\,0<x<1,\,0<y<1, \\ 2x\text{ }\,{e}^{y},\, & \text{if}\,0<x<1,\,1<y<2,\end{aligned}
$$

and  $R$ is the domain of $f.$

Question 2
?

Evaluate the double integral ∬Rf(x,y)dA, where f(x,y)={3x2,if0<x<1,0<y<1,2x ey,if0<x<1,1<y<2, and R is the domain of f.

a
 1−e2
b
 1+e2+e
c
 1+e2−e
d
 1−e2
e
 1+e2
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

First, notice that we have R=R1∪R2, where R1=(0,1)×(0,1) and R2=(0,1)×(1,2). So, we can write

∬Rf(x,y)dA=∬R1f(x,y)dA+∬R2f(x,y)dA=∬R13x2dA+∬R22x eydA=(1−0)∫013x2dy+(∫012xdx)(∫12eydy)=x3|01+(x2|01)⋅(ey|12)=1+1⋅(e2−e1)=1+e2−e.
